narrativeAssessment: Supported condensed story of an animals life: hunger and danger, mother/den, persecution and separation, work and violence, exploitation, rescue, slow attachment, departure, difficult southern adaptation, final peril and puppies. Scenes carry the transformation without digest-writers moral or management lessons. Essential/Core coherently stop at bulldog arrival, Deep completes the arc after warning. No material invented scene, direct speech, motive, reversed relationship or missing decisive outcome found.
parityAssessment: All RU/EN title/subtitle/body pairs read. Meaningful parity in actors, causal links, emotional development, uncertainty, cruelty and outcomes. Russian is assessed as a new original condensation, not as a published translation. No required translation mismatch.

primaryScenesActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Coffin journey, extra fish for six dogs, later stolen fish, she-wolf decoy and dwindling team.
One Ear escape, Bill follows with three rounds; Henry hears death without witnessing it; fire-circle exhaustion, body-as-meat and sled party rescue.
Food permits pack breakup, rivals and One Eye, cave under clay bank, newborn family and One Eye hunting. Selected primary runs, not entire chapters continuously.
Grey coat, early warmth/play, siblings dying and she-wolf follows One Eyes trail to lynx battle remains.
Light as cave wall, fall, twig/nose mishaps, ptarmigan brood, hawk narrowly misses cub, apparent solid water, mother-weasel and she-wolf rescue.
She-wolf kills lynx litter, cub eats kitten, lynx follows, hind-leg grip, deep shoulder wound, lynx death and weakened survivors beside carcass.
First man/bite/blow, Kiche recognition and mixed ancestry/name, fire from moss and sticks, burns nose/tongue, crowd laughter and shelter with Kiche.
Lip-lip and pack persecution, stolen meat, no equal play, sudden attacks and wheeling on leading pursuer.
Kiche pays debt to Three Eagles, White Fang follows canoe, Grey Beaver catches/beats/kicks him and separation.
Deliberate hiding as camp moves, cold/loneliness, long pursuit, expected blow replaced by food and protection.

primaryScenesActuallyChecked.primaryLocation: III.V; IV.I, especially III.V lines 153–175, 261–281 and IV.I 24–75
primaryScenesActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Sled work, guarding and food/protection covenant without caresses; later leader placement makes hostile team chase him. The earlier Lip-lip lead in puppy harness is not confused with White Fangs later lead.
Famine, Kiche and new litter, Lip-lip killed, smell of fish and return to camp.

primaryScenesActuallyChecked.primaryLocation: IV.I–II, especially IV.I lines 162–230, 232–275 and IV.II 112–132
primaryScenesActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Trading/gold seekers/steamers, White Fangs own lethal attacks and pack finishes dogs, Smith interest and initial refusal.
Alcohol/bottle purchase, repeated return to old master, severe beatings and chain; paid cage, dogs/wolves/lynx and spring bulldog arrival.

primaryScenesActuallyChecked.primaryLocation: IV.IV–V, especially IV.IV lines 222–339 and IV.V 88–225
primaryScenesActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: Bulldog shifts grip toward throat, Smith kicks, Scott punches him and Matt helps; revolver lever; killed Major, both men bitten and threat of shooting countered with another chance. Targeted fight/purchase/aftermath runs, not full continuous chapter reading.
Bandaged hand after prior bite, gentle speech, meat tossed then taken from hand, touch/terror/ambivalence without a blow or instant gratitude.
Waiting, sickness/refusal to eat during absence, recovery and head-hidden gesture, Smith with chain/club and Scotts calming response.
Decision to leave White Fang, locked doors, animal aboard ship, wounds/window inference, final whistle and Scott takes him.

primaryScenesActuallyChecked.primaryLocation: V.II, lines 5–108 and following Collie encounter
primaryScenesActuallyChecked.actuallyChecked: City fear, railway trip, mother embraces Scott at country railway arrival before carriage ride, Collie hostility at house grounds. Candidate mildly relocates the greeting into country home; noted separately as nonblocking precision.
Fifty hens, Scotts cuffs and voice, judge doubt and unharmed chickens; domestic/wild distinction, gradually liking children, learning laughter and safe play with Scott while aloof with other dogs.
Riding accident/broken leg, sending home, dress tugging, rare bark interpreted by Alice, Collies playful change/courtship.

Hall brutality history, earlier convictions, wrongful last fifty-year sentence, judge ignorance versus Halls belief, Alice secretly lets wolf sleep inside, silent stair attack, Hall dead and White Fang gravely wounded.
Severe wounds, tiny recovery odds, judges insistence on care, family nurses, bad dreams, weakness on first walk, Collie/puppies and final patient sunlight image.
